description: Defines a lightweight Codable wrapper 'AnyCodable' for handling heterogeneous JSON payloads, including encoding, decoding, equality, and hashing.

classes.name: AnyCodable
classes.description: A Codable, Hashable, Sendable wrapper for heterogeneous JSON data, capable of encoding and decoding various types including dictionaries and arrays.

methods.name: init(_ value: Any)
methods.description: Initializes AnyCodable with a value, normalizing it.

methods.name: init(from decoder: Decoder) throws
methods.description: Decodes a value from a Decoder, supporting multiple primitive and collection types.

methods.name: encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws
methods.description: Encodes the stored value into an Encoder, handling various types.

methods.name: normalize(_ value: Any) -> Any
methods.description: Normalizes NSNumber boolean values to Swift Bool.

methods.name: == (lhs: AnyCodable, rhs: AnyCodable) -> Bool
methods.description: Checks equality between two AnyCodable instances.

methods.name: hash(into hasher: inout Hasher)
methods.description: Hashes the stored value for use in hash-based collections.
